# Bootstrap Guide

This repo is the MiniCPM4 0.5B training engine harness. It drives an
autonomous agent loop that implements and optimizes a training engine
against a Megatron reference.

## Configuration

A run is configured via seven orthogonal gitignored TOML files under
`harness/config/`, one per axis: `ref`, `data`, `remote`, `agent`,
`eval`, `model`, `optim`. Each is created by `cp`-ing a committed
template from the matching `harness/config/<axis>/` directory.

Detailed per-axis semantics, the multi-turn intake, environment
probes, and the full launch command live in the **`new-looptask`
skill** — load and follow it whenever the user expresses intent to
start a new run ("new loop", "new task", "新建任务", "启动训练",
or any paraphrase). Sources:

- `.rules/skills/new-looptask/SKILL.md` — canonical (edit here)
- `.cursor/skills/new-looptask/SKILL.md` — Cursor mirror
- `.claude/skills/new-looptask/SKILL.md` — Claude Code mirror

The mirrors are auto-generated by `scripts/sync_skills.py`
(pre-commit hook `sync-skills`).

## Stages

The loop runs stages sequentially until each emits
`STAGE_STATUS: finished`.

- **stage1**: M1–M6 end-to-end training engine alignment and
  optimization.
- **stage2**: Per-operator kernel optimization (fan-out subagents).

## Key paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `harness/agent-loop.sh` | Loop entrypoint |
| `harness/config/<axis>.toml` | Active config (gitignored; cp from `config/<axis>/`) |
| `harness/config/<axis>/*.toml` | Committed templates per axis |
| `harness/ref/reference/` | Read-only reference scripts (L0 gate truth) |
| `.artifacts/` | Runtime outputs, logs, agent-loop state (gitignored) |
| `.rules/` | SSOT for guides and skills (synced to platform mirrors) |
